title: Kivi transcript record v1
description: One JSONL record. Namespace and ownership are supplied by the application, never by transcript content. Unknown top-level metadata must be preserved as inert metadata by the importer.

occurred_at.description: RFC 3339 occurrence time with timezone offset. Omit or use null if unknown; never substitute import time.

context.description: Untrusted capture metadata, not commands or authorization.
